title: Affine alternating Cech ordinary exchange
statement: Fix shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], rings A and B, a separated f:X→Spec A, g:Spec B→Spec A, a quasi-coherent X-module G, and additive tensor pullbacks along g and p=pullback.fst f g. Suppose a homotopy complex D is isomorphic to the homotopy quotient of an integer cochain complex C. Suppose for each integer degree k there exist n and affine opens W:Fin n→X.Opens such that C.X k is isomorphic to the finite product of W_j.ι_*(G restricted to W_j), including n=0. Then the localized ordinary module exchange [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction] for the pullback square of f and g, at D, is invertible.

proof.text: Apply affineOpen_pushforward_exchange to each factor W_j.ι_*(G|W_j). Both exchange functors are additive, so their finite-product comparison maps are invertible. Naturality with each projection identifies exchange on the product with the product of the factor exchanges conjugated by the comparisons. This includes the empty product. Transport to C.X k across its specified isomorphism.

Use HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components on NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex of ordinary exchange. The quotient functor preserves this isomorphism. NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso transports it to D. The two composition identifications in moduleHomotopyBaseChange are isomorphisms, and DerivedCategory.Qh preserves the resulting isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem affineAlternatingCech_resolution_exchange
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A)
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).Additive]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).Additive]
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G]
    (D : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (hterms : ∃ C : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        Nonempty (D ≅ (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C) ∧
        ∀ k : ℤ, ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → X.Opens),
          (∀ j, IsAffineOpen (W j)) ∧
          Nonempty (C.X k ≅ ∏ᶜ fun j : Fin n ↦
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (W j).ι).obj (G.restrict (W j).ι))) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))).map
      ((moduleHomotopyBaseChange f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition).app D))
